pr_title: tree: correctly handle NULLs annotated as a tuple type
pr_body:
Fixes #74729

Release note (bug fix): A bug has been fixed that caused errors when
trying to evaluate queries with NULL values annotated as a tuple type,
such as `NULL:::RECORD`. This bug was present since version 19.1.
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/78287)

___ *[pkg/sql/sem/tree/type_check.go, line 2614 at r1](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/78287#-MynC8DT3XSlNW9fNZZP:-MynKS4f35Lcs5pyiihR:bmprvhi) ([raw file](https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/44adf92165ec7942b0a74b4cb4a8e1c56b53e31d/pkg/sql/sem/tree/type_check.go#L2614)):*
Previously, yuzefovich (Yahor Yuzefovich) wrote…
Do we need to care about `CastExpr` too?
Yes, good point. However, only the AnnotateTypedExpr will cause internal errors like in #74729 because those are added by the system in some cases. I guess we do synthesize casts in some cases too, so maybe they could case internal errors.
@rafiss did you want to take another look before I merge?

Looks like a flake.
